summary: Boundary County tower site in the Kaniksu NF: a 1927 cupola cabin, later towers, and a 2001 sale that moved the timber tower; only footings and a flagpole were found in 2023.

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1927); 40' pole L-4 tower (1934 or 1935); treated timber tower with L-4 cab (1956 or 1957)
facts.status_note: Timber tower sold for off-site removal and moved in 2001; cement footings and a flagpole were found at the site on a 2023 visit

staffing.status: names listed 1933 to 1981; no later staffing described

visit.trail_note: A 2023 Idaho Fire Lookouts visit found the drive to the location a very easy ride

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone and kind tower hold up. Brief lists two coordinate sets (FFLA 48.96206,-116.36136; Idaho Fire Lookouts 48.97384,-116.37159) that are not resolved here; the story gives no coordinates. Access level is omitted because no source says whether the land is open to the public today; visit.drive_up is true from the 'Drive-Up' label and the easy-ride note on the 2023 post. Staffing lists come from two fan sites that differ: Idaho Fire Lookouts adds 1938 (Roy Meeker), 1940 (Lester Spurgeon) and 1970 (Deborah Schleef) names that firelookout.com does not list. No fire history or rental information found.
